Run seed 18288113832071084461 is the first 64 bits of SHA-256('52420c03c47e092bf88b2471691fbd527acbb222|2026-08-18T19:51:49-04:00'); uniform sampling over the sorted diversity-eligible roots selected drunk-drivers. The selected root contains one existing incident packet and no investigation-target records in its manifest, so the target-stage pool collapses to the single existing Kearns DUI case subject; target seed 4468281321018733648 is the first 64 bits of SHA-256(run-seed|drunk-drivers|target-stage-v1). Ste. 1701, West Jordan, UT 84088, while the team page places Judge Stephen Nelson under West Jordan; KSL identifies Nelson as Guzman's sentencing judge.
